audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+, deciding where a February date works. They plan from the other side of the world and fear a generic result for a lot of money.

payload.search_intent: Informational, early consideration: which destinations suit a February wedding and what to watch for.
payload.angle: February is a two-hemisphere month. Rank ten destinations across four February conditions (Indian Ocean and Andaman dry season, Gulf cool season, Alpine snow, southern late summer), each with one honest caveat, then say plainly where to wait. Show the invisible work: Ramadan timing in the Gulf, Valentine's week minimum stays, seaplane and mountain transfers, weather backups.
serp_gaps_to_win: AU top 10 has no page answering the query: winter venue lists, honeymoon lists and Instagram only.
No competitor covers Ramadan falling in February in the next few years (researcher to confirm 2027 and 2028 dates from an official source).
No competitor flags Valentine's week demand for wedding blocks or where not to marry in February.
PAA 'Is February a good time for a wedding?' unanswered by a wedding-specific page.

shortlist.fit: Peak dry season; our live honeymoon-February page calls it often the driest month with calm seas.
shortlist.caveat: Seaplane transfers are daylight only and Valentine's week minimum stays apply; legal marriage for foreigners is restricted (symbolic ceremony likely, researcher to confirm).

shortlist.destination: Phuket and the Andaman coast, Thailand
shortlist.fit: Driest, least humid month on the Andaman coast per our honeymoon-February page.
shortlist.caveat: No Thailand page yet; link the Asia hub. Legal marriage runs through the embassy and local amphur (researcher).

shortlist.fit: Our best-time page calls February among the most comfortable months, with venues filling early.
shortlist.caveat: Ramadan likely starts in early-to-mid February 2027 (verify): affects music, alcohol and daytime events; book early-February dates or after Eid.

shortlist.fit: Our honeymoon-February page calls February one of the last mild months in the Gulf; beach-to-desert in one weekend.
Our Qatar page names November to April as the best time for outdoor weddings.
shortlist.caveat: Ramadan caveat; legal route depends on faith and nationality (researcher).

shortlist.fit: Our Mexico guide says December to April falls outside both hurricane seasons.
shortlist.caveat: Long haul from Australia (via the US); February is peak resort season, so room blocks go early.

shortlist.fit: Our honeymoon-February page calls February one of Queenstown's most settled summer months; short flight for Australian guests.
shortlist.caveat: No NZ page; link the Oceania hub. Mountain weather still needs an indoor backup.

shortlist.fit: Our January summer-and-winter page cites Discover Tasmania: warmest months December to March. No overseas paperwork for Australians.
shortlist.caveat: Bushfire season; total fire bans can stop outdoor flames and fireworks (researcher to source). Link only the magazine, not the 'Coming This Spring' pre-register page.

shortlist.fit: Our Switzerland page: winter (December to March) turns the Alps into a snowy setting for chalet and ski weddings.
shortlist.caveat: Short daylight, cold, transfers weather dependent; small guest lists; civil requirements vary by canton.

shortlist.fit: Our Europe destinations page cites Visit Madeira on a mild climate all year: the one Southern-Europe-style option that works in February.
shortlist.caveat: Mild, not warm, and showers likely: plan a quinta with covered space. Researcher must confirm February conditions from IPMA or Visit Madeira; drop to a 'wait' if not supported.

where_to_wait.why: Wet season; our own Bali timing page advises outdoor ceremonies outside October to April.
Wet and cyclone season; our Fiji page points to April, May and October.
Off season; many island venues closed.
